vision: KAITO'S CURIOS becomes the self-aware showpiece of the portfolio: a cozy haggling trading puzzle whose 8-day arc genuinely escalates, whose haggle mini-game rewards reading the merchant, and — above all — whose core promise lands: dealing with Kaito reveals who Kaito actually is (UofC software engineering, 3.94 GPA, ISKF karate champion, self-taught game dev who shipped 'I'm Slime', now Senior SWE at Finofo). The game must GUARANTEE the player meets the real Kaito and end with a fourth-wall moment pointing to the rest of the site, and it must measure whether that conversion actually happens. North star: a hiring manager who plays for 5 minutes comes away thinking 'this person can design a system, balance an economy, ship polished and accessible UX, AND tell a story about themselves' — at portfolio scope, never an over-built commercial title. Keep the from-scratch art, seeded pure engine, and a11y rigor. Scope discipline is explicit: Phases 0-2 (story-reachability, error boundary + records migration, the balance harness, the atomic economy rebalance, vitest) are MANDATORY and are where 'industry-standard engineering' is earned; Phases 3-6 are cherry-picked by impact, NOT completed exhaustively. We deliberately CUT the commercial-roguelite wishlist (meta-currency, between-run upgrade shop, ascension/endless, daily/shareable seeds, full TypeScript migration, a bespoke portrait mobile layout, and a 40-item catalog) because a 5-minute recruiter never sees that machinery. The two highest-value adds beyond correctness are the haggle-mood/per-item variety and the graded RANK + fourth-wall close; the single most important non-feature is a conversion event proving 'reached the Finofo card → clicked through to Projects.'
currentStateAssessment:
REAL STRENGTHS (verified, keep wholesale): (1) shopEngine.js is a clean, pure, deterministic reducer with a mulberry32 PRNG threaded via state.rngState — re-render-safe and trivially testable; the can't-afford soft-lock is genuinely unreachable; StrictMode double-invoke is handled. (2) The cozy wood/parchment art direction, the 23-icon from-scratch inline-SVG set, and the rapport/backstory writing (real Kaito bio, shopData.js:164-206) are above portfolio average. (3) Accessibility is unusually conscientious: real focus trap with restoration, role=dialog/aria-modal everywhere, role=progressbar/role=img, reduced-motion + coarse-pointer coverage, and an AA-clearing palette (verified; the stale _audit/contrast.json describes a different page and is misleading). (4) Laptop/desktop height budget holds down to 1280x720.

REAL WEAKNESSES (verified): (1) THE STORY — the whole point — is unreachable for players who play well. The win-night returns at shopEngine.js:442-448 BEFORE the tier-reveal block at :451, and only ONE tier reveals per night (single if, not a loop), so a tier crossed on the final day is lost forever and tiers crossed two-at-once are delayed/dropped. Worse, rapport's +3 levers (overpay on buy at :353, undersell at :391) are anti-profit, so profit-optimal winners reach tier 6 in ~0% of runs — the two best resume lines (3.94 GPA, Finofo) are effectively never seen. (2) THE ECONOMY IS SOLVED: buy-near-floor/sell-into-demand yields a fixed ~50-70% margin that compounds while rent grows only 18%/day; difficulty INVERTS (rapport lowers ask/floor and raises concession; perks pile up), holding inventory is strictly dominated yet actively taught in TWO copy sites (help panel Shop.jsx:1033-1035 AND the in-haggle sell note ~790-791). (3) THE HAGGLE — the core mini-game — is one deterministic concession curve (0.55 + rapport*0.003) with no item/mood/event variance; rote after ~10 plays. (4) PRODUCTION GAPS the prior plan missed: NO React error boundary anywhere (verified zero hits) — a Shop render throw white-screens the ENTIRE portfolio for every visitor since all sections mount at load; loadRecords (Shop.jsx:115-123) is a shallow {...DEFAULT_RECORDS, ...stored} merge against a hardcoded '.v1' key with no migrate step; NO test suite on a pure engine begging for it; magic numbers scattered outside CONFIG; vmin-only sizing renders 4-7px text on small landscape; the haggle exchange is entirely silent to screen readers; and there is ZERO instrumentation to know whether the recruiter-conversion thesis works. (5) Content is thin (23 items, Relic has only 1 item, Food 2) and replayability collapses after the story is consumed once.

CORRECTION TO PRIOR DIAGNOSIS: the cited 'economy-sim.mjs' does NOT exist (verified: _audit/ holds only day1-check.mjs, depth-hold.mjs, rapport-softlock.mjs, reveal-schedule.mjs). The headline ~89%/96% win-rate numbers came from a sim that was never committed; the balance harness must be (re)built and committed BEFORE any economy tuning, or Phase 1 tunes against numbers nobody can reproduce.

themes.name: Make the story reachable and the payoff guaranteed
themes.rationale: The narrative reveal of the real Kaito is the entire reason this game exists in a portfolio. Two engine bugs (win-before-tier-check precedence, one-reveal-per-night cap) plus an anti-profit rapport design mean skilled winners never see the 3.94 GPA or Finofo cards. Every theme is downstream of 'the player meets the real Kaito'; this is the highest impact-x-confidence work in the audit and must ship WITH its tests in the same commit.

themes.name: Don't let the showpiece take down the portfolio, and don't corrupt returning players
themes.rationale: Two cheap, high-leverage production gaps the prior plan omitted. (1) A single render throw in the always-mounted 1149-line Shop subtree white-screens the WHOLE site for every visitor, including those who never scroll to it — an error boundary degrades that to a fallback card. (2) Phase 5 adds nested records fields (lore banking, achievement-gated anecdotes), but loadRecords shallow-merges a hardcoded '.v1' key — a versioned migrate() must land before any new shape is written, or early adopters' saved progress silently corrupts.

themes.name: Put survival genuinely at stake (winnable but not solved) — as one atomic change
themes.rationale: A trading puzzle whose economy is a solved, compounding arbitrage with ~near-100% win rate and INVERTING difficulty has no tension. Steepening rent, killing the risk-free same-day re-flip, category saturation, and the rapport re-curve all move the win rate TOGETHER; tuning them piecemeal will thrash and can make the game unwinnable. They must ship as ONE non-divisible PR gated on a rebuilt-and-committed Monte-Carlo balance test — including the reconciled 0.38->~0.50 opening-offer fix, which touches the SAME wanted/unwanted code path (shopEngine.js:247) as the re-flip kill.

themes.name: Skill expression and decision depth
themes.rationale: The single deterministic haggle curve and strictly-dominant fast-flip loop mean the player makes no meaningful choices after ~10 minutes. Per-item/mood haggle variance, a demand forecast, and a fuzzy threshold band create real reads and trade-offs — built entirely within the existing 11-portrait asset set (no new art is authorable in scope).

themes.name: Communicate state at the moment it happens
themes.rationale: Feedback is fragile: a single 3.4s toast slot clobbers the day-event banner, the haggle is silent to screen readers (the core loop is unplayable non-visually), tier-ups/last-day/near-bankruptcy are never surfaced, and Quick deal is a hidden 38%-of-value lowball trap. AAA feel is mostly legible, well-timed feedback — high impact for low-to-medium effort.

themes.name: Honest framing, a graded close, and a measured conversion
themes.rationale: Call it what it is (a cozy trading puzzle, not a roguelike). Give a graded end-of-run RANK and a fourth-wall close that points the visitor back to the Projects section and Codex. Crucially, INSTRUMENT it: a handful of lightweight events (game-started, Finofo-card-seen, fourth-wall-CTA-clicked) is the only way to validate the entire recruiter-conversion thesis the vision rests on.

themes.name: Legibility and reach across screens (cheaply)
themes.rationale: vmin-only sizing renders 4-7px text on small landscape and balloons on 4K; portrait is hard-blocked for ALL devices including tablets; a global touchmove preventDefault breaks modal scrolling on touch. A clamp() type scale, a dimension-aware gate, and a one-line touch-scroll guard widen the audience. The FULL bespoke portrait Shop layout is explicitly OUT of scope.

roadmap.phase: Phase 0 — Critical correctness + production safety (MANDATORY, single coordinated effort)
roadmap.goal: Every player who deals with Kaito reaches the real-Kaito payoff; no earned content/perk is ever silently lost; a Shop crash can never white-screen the portfolio; returning players' saved progress can't corrupt; and the load-bearing engine path is locked by tests in the SAME commit.
items: ERROR BOUNDARY (high, NEW — verified zero error boundaries exist in src/): add a React error boundary (getDerivedStateFromError + componentDidCatch) wrapping at minimum the Shop section in Home.jsx (ideally each section), rendering a graceful fallback card ('This section hit a snag — scroll on') instead of a white screen. Because Home.jsx mounts all sections at page load and the Shop is the largest, riskiest subtree (and gets the most new code in Phases 3-5), this is the cheapest highest-leverage robustness fix and must land here, not be deferred.

STORY REACHABILITY (critical, shopEngine.js:442-462): move the rapport tier-resolution ABOVE the victory check in sleep(), and replace the single `if (tierDef && next.rapport >= tierDef.at)` with a while-loop draining ALL crossed tiers — apply each perk off `next.perks` (NOT `state.perks`, which would drop all but the last), push each crossed RAPPORT_TIERS entry onto a `pendingTiers` array, THEN run the victory/generateDay branch.

WIN-NIGHT ROUTING (medium, NEW precision from critique): ackBackstory currently ALWAYS calls generateDay->'shop'. Make post-queue routing branch explicitly on victory: when pendingTiers empties AND day>=victoryDay, route to 'win', NOT generateDay (which would wrongly build a day-9 board). The shared enterShopAfterDayGen() helper must be used ONLY on the non-victory path.

BACKSTORY QUEUE UI (Shop.jsx ~166-174, 931-951): replace single `state.pendingTier` with the `pendingTiers` queue; ackBackstory shifts the head, stays in 'backstory' until empty, then routes per the win-night rule above. Bank each shown card into records.lore as it is revealed so the Codex never loses a beat.

GUARANTEE THE PAYOFF ON WIN (content critical, Shop.jsx RunEnd ~953-1005): regardless of rapport, add a 'Hear the rest' button on the win screen that reveals every still-locked beat in sequence and banks them; make the Codex render locked cards as readable after any win. This ensures the 3.94 GPA + Finofo lines are never missed even by a profit-maximizer — the lowest-risk way to guarantee the portfolio payoff.

RECORDS MIGRATION SCAFFOLD (medium, NEW — verified shallow merge at Shop.jsx:115-123, hardcoded 'kaitosCurios.records.v1'): add an explicit `migrate(stored)` step and bump the key/version BEFORE any new field shape is written (the lore banking above writes records.lore; Phase 5 adds achievements/anecdotes). Ship the migration plumbing now even though the v1->v2 transform is near-identity, so later nested fields can't silently break a returning visitor's save. This is a HARD prerequisite for Phase 2's useRecords extraction and all Phase 5 records writes.

VITEST HARNESS LANDS WITH THE FIX (critical sequencing): add vitest (zero-config with Vite) and, IN THE SAME PR as the story-reachability fix, write the multi-tier-drain test, the win-night-card test (tier crossed on final day is shown, not swallowed), the perks-stack-off-next.perks test, and the lore-banking idempotency test. Without these landing alongside, a regression here silently re-hides the entire reason the game exists.

DETERMINISM LEAKS (confirmed low, shopEngine.js:464-468 & 480-488): extract `enterShopAfterDayGen(next)` that calls generateDay, RE-SEEDS rng from the POST-generateDay rngState, calls setFace, and persists `next.rngState = rng.state`; use it in both sleep() and ackBackstory() so the greeting portrait draw is on-chain and not double-consumed.
STREAK ON BREAK-EVEN (confirmed low quick win, shopEngine.js:370): change `profit > 0` to `profit >= 0` so a break-even flip keeps the hot streak, matching the tooltip's 'a loss cools it off'.

TOUCH-SCROLL BUG (confirmed high, Home.jsx:109-110): guard the unconditional `event.preventDefault()` with `if (!isScrollable.current) return;` (the cleanest fix — setScrollable(!modalUp) already forces it false while a modal is up, so the preventDefault is pointless then anyway) so finger-scrolling works inside the Codex/Help modals on touch devices.

roadmap.phase: Phase 1 — Economy & difficulty rebalance (MANDATORY, ONE atomic PR gated on the balance sim)
roadmap.goal: A skilled player wins ~60-70% and a careless one loses; difficulty rises toward day 8; rapport perks and inventory decisions matter. Ship as a SINGLE non-divisible merge — these levers move the win rate together and tuning them piecemeal will thrash or break winnability.
items: REBUILD + COMMIT THE BALANCE SIM FIRST (NEW hard prerequisite — the cited economy-sim.mjs does NOT exist; verified _audit/ has only day1-check/depth-hold/rapport-softlock/reveal-schedule): write a deterministic N-seed Monte-Carlo harness that imports the REAL engine (not a re-implementation) and runs scripted greedy-but-fair AND profit-optimal policies, asserting win-rate bands. Commit it as a vitest balance-regression test. ALL tuning below is gated on this; tune against numbers, not vibes. This blocks the rest of Phase 1.

DECOUPLE RAPPORT FROM ANTI-PROFIT (confirmed, shopEngine.js:352-357,389-392): stop rewarding overpaying/underselling. Buy gain = +2 for any non-insulting buy (price>=floor), +1 otherwise; remove the `price<=ceil*0.96` penalty so any wanted sell = +2, unwanted = +1; add +1 if the deal closed on the first offer. Keep the -3 insult penalty. Re-tune RAPPORT_TIERS thresholds (currently 12/28/46/66/88/110) BY SIMULATION so a clean ~16-20-deal winning run organically reaches tier 6.

KILL THE INSTANT SAME-DAY RE-FLIP + RECONCILED OPENING-OFFER FIX (critical, shopEngine.js:348,244,247,502 — these touch the SAME code path, design together): tag bought instances with `boughtDay: state.day`; in startHaggle sell-side and sellProjection, suppress the wanted bonus when `inst.boughtDay === state.day` (fall back to dumpFactor). Because a same-day-bought wanted item then routes through the unwanted branch, fold the former quick-win '0.38->~0.50 opening offer' (shopEngine.js:247) into THIS change rather than shipping it standalone — design the unwanted opening as `dumpFactor*0.8` so it isn't a hidden 38%-lowball trap AND interacts correctly with the re-flip suppression.

STEEPEN RENT + DEFLATE SNOWBALL (confirmed, shopData.js:14 & shopEngine.js:152,374): raise rentGrowth 1.18->~1.26 and/or add a flat escalating step (rent += 12*(day-1)); cap the streak tip at `Math.min(streak-1,3)` instead of 5; add a telegraphed day-8 'season-end tax' (~2.5-3x normal rent) shown from day 1 so the run is a savings target.

DEMAND FORECAST (confirmed high — highest-leverage depth fix, converts holding from -EV to +EV): generate day N+1's wants during sleep() and surface 1-2 on the day-end card ('A gem caravan arrives tomorrow, +35%'). This makes the 'hold' pillar actually true — and is a hard co-dependency of the re-flip kill (without it, killing same-day flips can leave the game frustrating/unwinnable).

CATEGORY SATURATION (confirmed high, completeSell): decay the wanted bonus per same-category sale that day (effective bonus *= 0.7^salesOfCategoryToday via a per-day per-category counter). Breaks unbounded same-day churn, makes spreading sales across days correct, and finally makes the +2-slots perk meaningful.

FIX BOTH 'HOLD' COPY SITES (NEW from critique, low but do it in this PR): the strictly-losing 'hold the rest' advice appears in TWO places — the help panel (Shop.jsx:1033-1035) AND the live in-haggle sell note (~790-791). The in-haggle note is the more damaging (it's the decision point). Once the forecast + saturation make holding genuinely +EV, correct/keep both; until then they must not teach a losing line.

REBALANCE / RE-THEME PERKS (partial medium, shopData.js:154-159, shopEngine.js:471-478): patience's benefit is capped by the conv=value*0.02 auto-close, so either shrink conv per patience point or convert patience into a value-peek; buff discount to ~8%/5% and extend it to the sell ceiling; keep appraise at tier 1.

ADD ADVERSITY EVENTS (partial low, shopData.js:139-151 + new engine handlers): wire NEW effect keys (patienceMod, wantBonusMod, goldTax) and add 'Kaito's Grumpy', 'Market Slump', 'Tax Audit'; bias the day-2+ draw toward adverse on later days. Currently 9/11 events are pure upside, reinforcing the too-easy curve.
RE-RUN THE SIM AND CONFIRM before merge: target ~60-70% sensible / ~85% optimal. The whole PR merges or doesn't.

roadmap.phase: Phase 2 — Foundations: enable safe, fast feature work (lean — TS migration and the events-queue refactor are CUT)
roadmap.goal: Lock current behavior with tests, centralize tuning, fix the records lifecycle, and decompose only the hotspots that unblock Phase 3 — without burning budget on speculative refactors.
items: EXPAND VITEST COVERAGE (builds on Phase 0/1 harness): reducer unit tests (seeded createRun determinism, scripted buy/sell deltas, insult -3 rapport/-2 patience at :294-295/:313-314, patience-exhaustion->final at :320-323, sleep gold<rent->over, victoryDay->win). The multi-tier-drain, win-night, and balance-regression tests already exist from Phases 0-1; broaden edge coverage here.

CENTRALIZE MAGIC NUMBERS (clearly correct, shopEngine.js multiple): promote inline constants into structured CONFIG (CONFIG.haggle {concessionMin/Max, rapportSlope, convFrac}, CONFIG.pricing {askMarkup, floorMarkup, askRelief}, CONFIG.rapport {cap, insultPenalty, thresholds}, CONFIG.streak {tipUnitFrac, tipCap}, CONFIG.events {chance, biasFrac}) so a balance pass is a single-file edit and the regression test can parametrize difficulty. Derive RAPPORT_MAX from RAPPORT_TIERS.at(-1).at instead of the magic 140.

EXTRACT useRecords WITH MIGRATION (gated on Phase 0 migration scaffold): pull persistence into a useRecords() hook returning [records, mutateRecords] that computes-next/persists/setState atomically (removes the manual ref+state triplication) and OWNS the migrate(stored) step. This is the safe home for all Phase 5 records writes.

DEFER RUN CREATION TO FIRST FOCUS (multiple lenses, Shop.jsx:149-152 + Home.jsx): keep the reducer idle until isfocus first becomes true, then dispatch RESTART with a fresh Date.now() seed — aligns the seed with actual play, avoids generating a run for every page-loader, and gives a clean 'start' moment.

PERFORMANCE BUDGET FOR THE ALWAYS-MOUNTED ARCHITECTURE (NEW from critique): set a concrete gate — homepage TTI/Lighthouse must not regress as Phase 5 juice lands. Pause off-screen infinite animations (content-visibility:auto or animation-play-state:paused keyed off isfocus) so the always-mounted Shop isn't burning idle GPU for visitors who never reach it. Measure before/after; this is the budget, not a vibe.

DECOMPOSE ONLY THE HAGGLE HOTSPOT (opportunistic, NOT a hard upfront gate, Shop.jsx:609-871): extract the 263-line HaggleModal into HaggleModal.jsx with a useHaggleOffer(h,gold) hook (removes the double opening()/double clampP smell at 620/623-628/636) BECAUSE Phase 3 lives there. Optionally pull the modal family behind one shared <Modal> wrapper to kill per-dialog boilerplate. Do the rest of the Shop.jsx split only where it unblocks a feature — let tests, not a folder structure, be the safety net.

DELETE DEAD CODE (multiple confirmed low): remove .offerValue (Shop.module.css:1000-1006), wire dayStartGold (shopEngine.js:169) into a true day-net ledger line or delete it, merge .flipTag/.wantedTag into one .ribbonTag, add dayDeals:0 to createRun's initial literal, and DELETE the stale _audit/contrast.json (it describes a different page and is actively misleading).

CUT (explicit): do NOT migrate the engine to TypeScript — the vitest reducer tests already catch the 'wrong field on wrong side' class of bug, and a full TS pass burns budget a 5-minute player never benefits from. If any typing is wanted, JSDoc @typedef on State/Action/Haggle + checkJs only. Do NOT build the unified events queue speculatively — the two-counter sfx.n/toast.n pattern works; only build a queue if/when Phase 5's coin-burst juice actually needs multiple cues per action.

items: PORTRAIT-ASSET CONSTRAINT (NEW from critique, read first): the mood/expression work below MUST use only the existing 11 webp assets (PORTRAITS map, shopData.js:68-77 — greet/think/deal/pleased/annoyed/insult/walk/idle already remap these). There is NO bespoke 'eager/wary/stubborn' art and none is authorable in scope, so map moods to existing expressions (e.g. stubborn->annoyed/think, eager->pleased/greet) rather than scoping art that can't ship.

PER-ITEM HAGGLE PERSONALITY (confirmed high, shopData.js + shopEngine.js:276): add a data-driven `haggle` profile per item/category (sentimental: concession -0.1, patience -1; overstocked: concession +0.2, patience +1; valueNoise for mysterious items). Compute `concession = clamp(base + rapport*slope + item.haggle + mood.delta, 0.40, 0.90)` keeping the reducer pure.

HAGGLE MOOD (confirmed high, shopEngine.js startHaggle): roll a mood from the threaded rng, store on state.haggle.mood, show via an EXISTING portrait expression + distinct quip BEFORE the first offer, and apply ±0.15 concession / ±1 patience so reading his face matters.

FUZZ THE THRESHOLD TICK (a11y/gameplay, Shop.jsx:664-675): the slider paints Kaito's exact floor/ceil as a hard tick regardless of appraise, leaking the optimal edge. Replace with a fuzzy band whose width shrinks with rapport/appraise (±15% at rapport 0 -> ±3% high) so 'read the merchant' is real skill; gate the exact `worth ~{value}` behind a deeper perk. This is the prerequisite that makes hidden moods/personalities meaningful.

FINAL-OFFER / PRECISION REWARDS (gameplay, shopEngine.js:353,391): add a 'final offer — take it or leave it' commit button with real risk, and grant a small 'sharp eye' tip when the closed price lands within `conv` of the floor/ceil, rewarding precision over slider-mashing.

Patience {p} of {max}.' / insult / final / deal-with-profit-and-rapport. Add the missing .srOnly class. This is the difference between operable and playable non-visually. Enrich the slider aria-valuetext with band context ('within the fair range' vs 'he'll take it as an insult'), derived from the SAME clamped value as `value`.

RELABEL QUICK DEAL + WARN ON LOWBALL (ux confirmed, Shop.jsx:853-860): rename to 'Take his offer ({N})' for sells; when h.offer < h.ceil or < paid show inline subtext 'his opening — ask up to ~{ceil}'. (The numeric 0.38->~0.50 opening bump itself lives in the Phase-1 atomic PR; this is the labeling/warning half.)

SPLIT THE TOAST CHANNEL (ux partial medium, Shop.jsx:1136-1151): stop routing the day-event through the single 3.4s toast (it already persists in the eventChip — just pulse it at day start); give actionable errors (bag full, can't afford) a dedicated sticky slot that clears on next action; reserve the toast for transient feedback.

FIRST-HAGGLE COACHMARK (ux partial medium): gate on a localStorage flag; on the FIRST haggle, anchor an arrow to the slider ('Drag toward what it's worth — lowball him and patience drops') and label Quick deal vs Offer. CLAMP TYPE SCALE (responsive confirmed high + visual confirmed high, Shop.module.css pervasive vmin): introduce --fs-* tokens as clamp(min,vmin,max) on .root AND .overlay; map HUD/buttons/ledger/labels/micro readouts so nothing drops below ~11px on small landscape or balloons on 4K; cap the column grid with minmax(clamp(120px,13vmin,180px),1fr); then delete the partial media-query patch.

FIX THE FONT-WEIGHT BUG (visual confirmed, index.html:30 vs Shop.module.css): Fraunces is loaded only at 600/700 but every display element requests 800 -> faux-bold. Change the seven 800s to 700 (or add 900 to the font request) + font-synthesis:none so future mismatches fail visibly.

Perk drafting (1-of-3) is the ONLY optional roguelite lever worth keeping, and only IF the perk catalog is expanded — treat as stretch, not core.

items: FIX THE PORTRAIT GATE (responsive confirmed high, S-effort, Home.jsx:45-58,160): replace the pure aspect-ratio block (`innerWidth <= innerHeight`) with a dimension-aware guard via matchMedia('(orientation:portrait) and (max-width:700px)') so iPad/tablet portrait and tall desktop windows are no longer hard-blocked; rewrite the gate copy ('Rotate to landscape to play') and make its image responsive/inline-SVG.

SMALL-VIEWPORT TWEAKS (responsive medium, complements the Phase-4 clamp scale): add @media(max-height:560px) lowering the .portraitFrame 150px floor (clamp(96px,22vmin,240px)) and .bagEmpty min-height; add dvh->vh fallbacks (height:100vh; height:100dvh;) for older Safari/Firefox; switch 100vw roots to 100% to avoid scrollbar-gutter overflow.

CUT (explicit, per critique): the full bespoke portrait Shop layout (stack HUD, move demand board, 2-wide shelf, horizontal bag strip) is L-effort for a desktop-leaning portfolio whose other sections are also landscape-gated. Out of scope — the dimension-aware gate is the real, cheap win.

quickWins: Streak survives break-even: change `profit > 0` to `profit >= 0` (shopEngine.js:370) — one char, matches the tooltip, removes a feels-bad reset (S).

Error boundary around the Shop section (Home.jsx) — a few dozen lines of a classic getDerivedStateFromError class component prevents a Shop render throw from white-screening the ENTIRE portfolio for every visitor (S-M, high impact, verified no boundary exists today).
Touch-scroll fix: guard Home.jsx:110's unconditional preventDefault with `if (!isScrollable.current) return;` — restores Codex/Help scrolling on every touch device (S, confirmed high).

Font-weight fix: change the seven Fraunces font-weight:800 declarations to 700 (or add 900 to index.html:30) + font-synthesis:none — removes faux-bold on every title, the most visible 'cheapening' tell (S, confirmed).

Relabel Quick deal to 'Take his offer ({N})' for sells with an 'ask up to ~{ceil}' subtext — kills the legibility half of the hidden 38%-lowball trap NOW (S). NOTE: the numeric 0.38->~0.50 opening-offer change is NOT a standalone quick win — it shares the wanted/unwanted code path (shopEngine.js:247) with the Phase-1 same-day-reflip kill and MUST ship inside that atomic PR.
Delete confirmed dead code: .offerValue (CSS 1000-1006), the stale _audit/contrast.json (wrong page entirely), merge .flipTag/.wantedTag (S).
Drop the 'roguelike' label in copy/intro/Help/MEMORY — it's a fixed-length seeded trading puzzle; zero code risk, removes a false promise (S).
Add the .srOnly class + a single haggle aria-live region — turns the core loop from operable-only to actually playable for screen-reader users (M but very high impact, confirmed critical).
risks: BALANCE-GATE PREMISE WAS BUILT ON A FILE THAT DOESN'T EXIST. The cited economy-sim.mjs is not in _audit/ (verified). The inherited ~89%/96% win-rate numbers are unreproducible. The harness MUST be rebuilt and committed (Phase 1, item 1) BEFORE any economy tuning, or the rebalance tunes against numbers nobody can verify.

The story-reachability fix touches the most load-bearing engine path (sleep tier-drain + win precedence + pendingTiers queue + win-night routing + Codex banking across StrictMode). Its multi-tier-drain + win-night + perks-stack tests MUST land in the SAME commit (Phase 0), not after — a silent regression here re-hides the entire reason the game exists.

The Phase-1 economy set is a SINGLE NON-DIVISIBLE PR, not a checklist. Rent steepening, the same-day-reflip kill, category saturation, the demand forecast, and the rapport re-curve move the win rate together. Killing the re-flip removes the ONLY currently-viable loop, so the forecast + saturation MUST ship in the same merge or the game can become unwinnable/frustrating. Re-simulate before merge; for a solo dev this is the discipline most likely to be violated.

The 0.38->0.50 opening-offer change and the re-flip kill touch the SAME code path (shopEngine.js:247). Do NOT ship the numeric bump as a standalone quick win and then re-touch it in Phase 1 — design them together inside the atomic PR.

Records schema has no migration path today (shallow merge, hardcoded '.v1', verified). The migrate() scaffold is a HARD prerequisite before Phase 0's lore banking and all Phase 5 records writes — otherwise returning players' nested fields silently corrupt. Bump the version before writing any new shape.

Portrait-asset reality: there are only 11 webp expressions and no bespoke mood art is authorable in scope (verified PORTRAITS map reuses the same 11). The Phase-3 mood/personality features must map to existing expressions, or they silently can't ship.

Scope creep toward 'commercial roguelite' is the dominant risk and is explicitly disowned: meta-currency, between-run shop, ascension/endless, daily/shareable seeds, full TS migration, the bespoke portrait layout, and a 40-item catalog are all CUT. Phases 0-2 are mandatory; Phases 3-6 are cherry-picked by impact. The guaranteed story payoff, the error boundary, and the conversion event matter far more than any of the cut machinery.

Conversion is unmeasured today. If the lightweight instrumentation (Phase 5) is skipped, there is no way to know whether the recruiter-conversion thesis — the whole point of the vision — actually works; treat the Finofo-card-seen and CTA-clicked events as part of the close, not optional analytics polish.

Several high-leverage UX/visual findings remain 'unverified' (toast split, perk re-theme details, micro-interactions, small-viewport tweaks). Verify each against current code before implementing — this audit already caught overstated claims (the lore-banking 'permanent loss' and streak-double-count findings were refuted/overstated, and 'economy-sim.mjs' was cited but absent).
